2. Count unique products per segment for 2020 and 2021

Let me write the SQL query:

```sql
SELECT 
    hdp.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hdp.product_code) AS unique_products_2020,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hfs.fiscal_year = 2021 THEN hdp.product_code END) AS unique_products_2021,
    100 * (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hfs.fiscal_year = 2021 THEN hdp.product_code END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hfs.fiscal_year = 2020 THEN hdp.product_code END)) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hfs.fiscal_year = 2020 THEN hdp.product_code END) AS percentage_increase
FROM 
    hardware_dim_product hdp
LEFT JOIN 
    hardware_fact_sales_monthly hfs ON hdp.product_code = hfs.product_code
WHERE 
    hdp.segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    hdp.segment
ORDER BY 
    percentage_increase DESC
```
